rows.title: Child Outcomes Summary Process: Teamwork to Data Submission
rows.description: Child Outcomes Summary Process Presentation to Special Education Directors: Teamwork to Data Submission. This presentation provided a detailed overview of the COS process, focusing on how teams rate children's skills in three outcome areas for early childhood special education programs, and the importance of accurate data submission. Links to resources, tools, Q&A's and crosswalks to assessment tools were provided.

rows.title: October 1 Enrollment Webinar
rows.description: Maine’s Essential Programs and Services (EPS) formula relies on student enrollment data as of October 1 of each school year. This report is required to be certified by superintendents for state funding allocations to be calculated. Data collected at this point are also used, in some cases, for federal reporting requirements. This webinar will review the report components and requirements in Connect and NEO.

rows.title: Grants4ME Training
rows.description: The Fiscal team conducted a Grants for Maine training session focused on the early childhood special education ECSE transition process. They explained key requirements including the need for LEA Pre-K, Special Education Program Monitoring Director user access, and emphasized the importance of confirming the correct quarter before entering data and verifying that trial balance totals match Grants for Maine reports. The session included guidance on uploading required documentation, particularly detailed trial balances and supporting expenditure documentation under the Related Documents tab, with an emphasis that IEP team decisions drive appropriate expenditures.

rows.title: Dropout Reporting Webainr
rows.description: If a student was enrolled last school year and exited from Synergy with a code that is anticipated to return, AND they are not enrolled on October 1 this school year they are statutorily considered a dropout for the previous school year. This webinar will review codes that are anticipated to return, and processes for validating the Dropout Report in NEO.

rows.title: Assessment Office Hours September 2026
rows.description: In this office hour, the Assessment Team shares updates related to the Maine Educational Assessments, including the Maine Through Year Assessment, Maine Science Assessment, ACCESS assessment, MSAA, and NAEP.

rows.title: Community of Practice Meeting for Business Managers
rows.description:
Childhood Special Education (ECSE) funding and data collections: Funding processes, Grants for Maine system issues. Upcoming changes:
Transition to collecting enrollment data through Connect instead of Synergy starting October 1st; New Child Find template; Upcoming training opportunities, including a Grants for Maine specific training scheduled for September 22nd, and discussed adjustments to the ECSE funding formula for FY28, including the restoration of EPS subsidy counts for 4-year-old students with IEPs.

rows.title: CTE Connect Enrollment Webinar
rows.description: Career and Technical Education (CTE) schools will be required to upload files to the new state reporting system, Connect, for CTE Credit Bearing for EPS Reporting. CTE Enrollments can be entered into Connect using SIF or Upload. This webinar will overview the process of uploading CTE Credit Bearing data and review enrollment validations in Connect.

rows.title: Special Education Connect Enrollment Webinar
rows.description: Students receiving special education services must have special education enrollments in Connect. This webinar will review the requirements for reporting special education enrollment data.
